title:
The UiSdlMapboxConfig type defines {@link UiSdlMapbox} configuration settings, including the access token required by the {@link UiSdlMapbox} API for rendering
tiles on the map.

By default, an access token is not provided, meaning that tiles will not be rendered. If a valid access token is provided, the map
will render with tiles.

More information about {@link UiSdlMapbox} access token can be found here: {@link https://docs.mapbox#com/help/glossary/access-token/}.
name: UiSdlMapboxConfig
